lesson: RULING for all-plants-backend (signal S-0015): do NOT add backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts to scope. The accepted fix is detect-and-refuse in MisStatementService, the same precedent the drill uses (decision 0025): pin {batchId, nodes} atomically, execute the blocks, then re-read the active budget outline and compare the batch id (and any block-reported budget batch id) with the pin; on mismatch return the existing 'refresh-required' outcome. The response can therefore never mix batches, which is what the three review findings require; a governed-SQL predicate change is a separate story.
